newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIUM APPOINTS ABRAHAMS TO SUCCEED NYSE'S UGEUX.
newsitem.headline: BELGIUM APPOINTS ABRAHAMS TO SUCCEED NYSE'S UGEUX.

text.p: Belgium on Friday named former Bank Paribas Belgium board member Jean-Paul Abraham, 66, as successor to Georges Ugeux as chairman of the state's privatization committee.
Ugeux, 51, is leaving the post to take up the position of Group Executive Vice President International on the board of the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE).

Ugeux was also until October 1 head of the European Union's Luxembourg-based European Investment Fund (EIF). His replacement there is Thomas Oursin, former secretary general of the European Investment Bank (EIB).
Ugeux has worked for Generale Bank, Morgan Stanley & Co., Societe Generale de Belgique and Kidder, Peabody & Co. Inc.
